translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Abarahama ibu igini aguanene maru henego ogo
Abarahama ibu mani wali mende mini Kedura dabu bini.
Ani dabu buwa wali ogoni ibugua igiri Simirana Yogosana Medana Midiana Isibaga Sua imaru taba hanaga bini.
Yogosana ibu Seba Dedanala aba hene. Dedana ibu Asurimi Ledusimi Lemimi uruninaga mamali hene.
Midiana ibu iginiru Ebabi Ebebi Hanogobi Abidabi Eledabi haga binigo uruni ti Kedura aguane hene.
Abarahama ibugua ibunaga paluni bibahende Aisagahondo miai hene.

Abarahama ibuni homa nabi howa ibu one mani dabu binigo igini bu henedaruni mo turu haga bialu mbirale migi biaga hene. Ani biaga henego ainde igiri uruni ti ibu igini Aisaga kagoria mandagi nahelo ti dindi kaundia ni tagira ibiragohayagi hole pudaba lene.
Abarahama homayagola tigua hora henego ogo
Abarahama ibu turu haga bialu waheore howa mali handari mbirani pira kariani duria (175) hayagola ibu homene.

Ani homayagola ibunaga tingini ibu igini Aisaga Isimalelame Mamere dindini homali Magabela egeanda biagoha hora hene. Homali ogoni Hidi hameigini Soha igini Eberononaga egeanda winigo ogoniha hora hene.
Dindi ogoni Abarahama ibugua Hidialinaga yolo bini wini. Ani bini winigoha Aisaga Isimalela libugua homali Sara hora hene wiagoha dege Abarahama hora hene.

Abarahama homayagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Aisaga bayuwaore biamogo bialu hene. Anigo Aisaga ibu nde iba uli wene mini Ngode Datagaliwabe Haluhe Kagome I̱ Handaga kagonaga laga iba bereagoria dindi mbira kaware wiagoria ibu haabo hene.
Isimalenaga igini aguaneneru henego ogo
Isimale ibu Saranaga garabaya biabe ale bia haga Iyibi wali mini Hega Abarahamala libu igini hene.
Ani henego Isimale igini waheneni howa daga lama pialu heyogone henego lamaro uru dege hene. Nebaiodo ibu igini wahene howa igini mende Keda tebone Adabele mane Mibisama
dauni Misima waragane Duma kane Masa hene.
Igini halini Hadada dini Tema pini Yadua beane Nabisi hombeane Kedema uruni haga bini.
Ani henego Isimale igini o biaruni ti hameigini hombearia (12) mani henerunaga mamali pigane ti hene. Tinaga mini dindi ti henedaruninaga mini winigo nga.
Isimale ibu mali handari mbirani pira tebirani karia (137) hayagola ibu homene.

Isimale aguaneneru ti Habila dindi Sua dindila hengeneha dindi wupe kagoha paluyu peda. Dindi Sua ogoni Asiria dindi pole hariga peagoria Iyibi dindi kaware ngelowa dege wia. Anigo hameigini uruni tini Abarahama aguanene maru hearu heba mandagi nahaga hene.
Iso Yagabala taba henenego ogo
Abarahama igini Aisaganaga bi te ogo.
Aisaga ibuni mali pira maria (40) howa ibu one Lebega dabu bini. Lebega ibu hameigini Aramia aria Mesobodemia dindini agali mbira Beduele henego wane biruwa Labana mbalini berene.
Aisagahanda ibu oneme waneigini nataba hanayagola ibu one biamogo bia lalu Anduane Homogohondo bi layagola Lebega ibu wali gali bere berene.

Lebega tombeha waneigini kira biruwa gungu biayuane handalu ibugua Anduane Homogohondo bi ogodagua lene. I̱ha ogonidagua biaruagoni agidabe, lene. Ibugua Anduane Homogohondo bi layadagoni aginaga binidabe hondolenaga lene.

Ani layagola Anduane Homogohanda bi ogobi ladai bini. Wali agali hameigini kira í̠naga tombeha bedabigo í̠na hameigini kira ogoni taba hanarengi libu hongo haga haga buleberabi. Hameigini mbiragome mendego bope holebira. Pigane taba hanarego ibu maha halu maha taba hanarego ibu mo wahene haragola wahene ibugua lone heyogonenaga biabe bia haga holebira, lene.
Lebega waneigini taba honolene tu hayagola heneneore igiri kira taba henene.
Igiri pigane taba hanayidago ibunaga tingini daramabioreni iri dewaheyagola ibunaga mini Iso wini.

Hamene mende taba hanayagola ogonime ibu hamene Isonaga ge ayuendeni yaniho yalu ibini. Ani binigonaga ibu mini Yagaba wini. Aisaga ibuni mali pira waragaria (60) heagola Lebegahanda igiri ogoni labo taba henene.
Iso ibuninaga wahene holene henge yu wahenego ogo
Igiri biago labo wahe halu Iso ibu tayanda irabuha taya haga mugubeyi hene. Yagaba ibu ibagaru nabi andaga hangu haga hene.
Aisaga ibugua ibu igini Isohanda nogo ega bo yalu ibiraru nolenaga turu howa ibu Iso dege gubalini haga hene. Anigo Lebega ibu nde Yagaba gubalini haga berene.
Horo mbirungi Iso ibu irabuha howa dai bialu hearia Yagaba ibu nde paboro subu bayale ngabiore dawaho berearia hendene.
Iso ibu tomo garibi timbuniore lama ibalu heariago ibugua lalu, Yagaba í̠na tomo subu iba baya daramabi dawedegoni maru abale noliya ngi, lene. Irane ogoninaga tigua Iso mini mende Idomo wini.
Ani layagola Yagabahanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na nde í̠ wahene holene henge yidegoni i̱ holiya ngiriyagua nde ngi larego ngulebero, lene.
Ani layagola Iso ibugua lalu, Ogoni karulape. Áyu garime tongo labehe kogodago. Wahenenaga holene henge ogonime i̱ biamogo agua bulubadabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yagabahanda lalu, Heneneore í̠naga henge i̱hondo ngule la, lene. Iso ibugua lalu, I̱na heneneore larogo i̱naga henge í̠ haore bibe, lene.

Ani laya handala Yagabahanda mberedi maru mialu paborome dawene subu baya ngabi dawa wiyarubi nelo miyagola Iso ibu nene. Nai halu Iso ibu heyalu pene. Ogoni binidagonime Iso ibuninaga holene henge bame nagaloneda manda bialu anidagua bini.

footnotes.text: 25.30 Idomo inanaga bi lalu daramabi laga.
